optional_public_mode: not executed; no qualified separate HTTPS fixture
scope_limits: Timed queue reads use first pages; full enumeration is separate functional setup.
Timed history reads use fixed records with ten initial events, in a larger table.
All initial exceptions are open; resolved-status selectivity is not qualified.
Fresh-state replicates share one cluster, shared host and operating-system caches.

Fast owned database stop/restart does not qualify power loss, failover or disaster recovery.
